title: Human and Copilot evolve this repository under accountable engineering controls

acceptance.metric: Valid canonical artifacts accepted and invalid mutations rejected
acceptance.target: All deterministic assertions pass; no mirrored reference authority or unbound executable bootstrap artifacts

acceptance.metric: Fresh-session behavioral scenarios satisfying every expected behavior and no forbidden behavior across all scripted turns, including useful completion and scope restraint
acceptance.target: Every scenario declared by the behavioral evaluation passes human review through the default Agent entry point; failures and inconclusive runs remain visible

acceptance.metric: Missing authority, authorization and unapproved active authority changes rejected
acceptance.target: All authority and transition assertions pass

acceptance.metric: Review conclusions traceable to current justification, durable reasoning and affected owning artifacts, including retention and removal
acceptance.target: Human review can trace each conclusion to its requirement, applicable decision, retained or changed artifacts and proof; historical rationale remains explainable after removal, without a separate learning registry or mandatory implementation change
